fidelity: F2a — Combustion + Steam-Cycle CHP with Lumped Boiler Thermal ODE
source: van Loo & Koppejan (2008) The Handbook of Biomass Combustion and Co-firing, Earthscan; Obernberger & Thek (2008) The Pellet Handbook; EN 303-5:2012; Moran, Shapiro et al. (2018) Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics

biomass_LHV_dry_MJ_kg.note: Dry LHV woody biomass; van Loo & Koppejan (2008) Tab 2.6 ~18-19 MJ/kg

h_fg_water_kJ_kg.note: Latent heat of vaporisation of water at 25 C; reduces LHV per kg moisture (van Loo & Koppejan 2008)

stoich_afr.note: Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio for dry woody biomass; van Loo & Koppejan (2008) Ch. 7

excess_air_ratio.note: Lambda, typical grate/fluidised-bed biomass combustion (van Loo & Koppejan 2008)

cp_flue_kJ_kgK.note: Mean specific heat of biomass flue gas 25-200 C; van Loo & Koppejan (2008)

cp_steam_kJ_kgK.note: Mean cp of superheated steam; Moran & Shapiro (2018) steam tables

T_flue_full_degC.note: Stack flue gas temperature at full load

radiation_loss_frac.note: Radiation + unburnt-carbon loss fraction of fuel input; van Loo & Koppejan (2008)

T_steam_K.note: Live steam temperature (~400 C back-pressure turbine)

T_back_pressure_K.note: Turbine exhaust / process-heat delivery temperature (~150 C)

eta_isentropic.note: Isentropic efficiency of back-pressure steam turbine; Moran & Shapiro (2018)

UA_loss_kW_K.note: Boiler shell heat-loss conductance to ambient
